title: Hermes Web Research Result
description: JSON object the quarantined profile must return for web_research to forward anything.

answer.description: Plain-text answer. An empty string is refused; whitespace is stripped before the check.

sources.description: Web sources cited for the answer. Only items whose url starts with http:// or https:// are forwarded.

url.description: Source URL. Must begin with http:// or https:// and contain no whitespace.

title.description: Human-readable source title; forwarded only when non-empty.

caveats.description: Warnings or uncertainty notes about the answer. An empty string is omitted from the envelope.
